decisionsTitle: A volunteer role without a number
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-15, on the screenshot of «Voluntari» → «Roluri» → «Adaugă un rol» («Câți oameni trebuie *»):** «Aici trebuie să pot pune și „fără număr”».

**Decision.** A role's needed count is optional: NULL is «fără număr» — any number of people, never full. Migration `0163_volunteer_role_no_number` is expand-only: it drops `NOT NULL` from `event_volunteer_roles.needed` and widens the CHECK to `needed IS NULL OR needed >= 1` (the checker reads dropping a NOT NULL, and replacing a CHECK by a wider one under its own name, as an expansion); every role from before keeps its number and its people.

**The form (amends §761, §765, §774).** «Adaugă un rol» and every role's «Modifică» carry the tick «Fără număr — oricâți oameni» (the house's `CheckboxField`, never a toggle; `name="unlimited"`) under «Câți oameni trebuie». The server decides by the tick (`volunteerRoleInputSchema`): ticked, the role has no number whatever the number box holds — a forged post may fill it, a form without scripts keeps it; unticked, the number is a whole number from 1 to 1000. Neither is refused at the number's box («Verifică acest câmp»), and the tick's help names both ways: «Rolul se oferă mereu … Nebifat, scrie mai sus un număr de cel puțin 1.» The box is hidden while the tick is on by the stylesheet alone (`:has`), so there is no client island and nothing to script; it is never `required`, because a hidden required box would block the press without a word — the server's refusal is the one rule. A role saved from numbered to none (or back) audits the field `needed`; an edit that changes nothing writes nothing.

**Everywhere the number is read (amends §761, §764, §773, §774, §780).** `RoleStanding.free` is `null` for such a role and every reader asks one rule, `roleTakesPeople`, never `free > 0`: the public form never stops offering the role however many people it was given (`openChoices`, `someRoleNeedsPeople`, `volunteerBoxRoles`), the event page's callout «Căutăm voluntari: …» lists it while the form is open, and the form is closed for «noRoleNeeds» only when no role takes people. **Decided (open point):** the public count line says «mai sunt locuri» for it whatever the tick «Arată public câți voluntari mai sunt necesari» says — never a number, and not «oricâți» (a word that reads as a promise); a numbered role beside it keeps its «mai sunt necesare N persoane». The card's role header reads «3 · fără număr» (the open glyph, no warning colour: nothing is owed) where a numbered role reads «3 din 10»; the card's closed line counts only the numbered roles («0 din 10 + roluri fără număr»; with none numbered, «3 în roluri fără număr»); the assignment buttons say «Ajutor · 3 · fără număr». The badges' «Câte ecusoane» for such a role starts at the people the organizers gave it (`BadgeRole.assigned`, the cancelled never counted; per-role mode of §764) and the box stays the club's to raise; the print page says so. The event's JSON file carries `needed: null` and an import as a new event adds the role through the card's own tick, so it stays without a number; the file's version is not raised (`needed` only gains the value null: a release from before refuses such a file as any value it does not know, and a file from before reads as it always did). The CSV, the agreement's role sentences and the emails print no number and are unaffected.

**Refused.** A zero or a very large number standing for «no limit» (a magic value a report would then add up); a separate toggle button (the house's rule: an on/off setting is a real tick); hiding the box with a client island (a server component with CSS does it, and works with scripts off); a «full» notion for the role (it is never full, so the public form needs no new state).
changelogLine: - **A volunteer role without a number** — «Fără număr — oricâți oameni» in «Adaugă un rol» and «Modifică»: the role is never full and always offered, reads «3 · fără număr» on the card, says «mai sunt locuri» on the page, and «Câte ecusoane» starts at the people given it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends the volunteers' card criteria (§761, §765, §774). Given «Adaugă un rol» or a role's «Modifică», then «Câți oameni trebuie» has beside it the tick «Fără număr — oricâți oameni» (a checkbox of at least 44 pixels, never a toggle button) with a help that names both ways, and the number box is hidden while it is ticked by the stylesheet alone; the server decides by the tick — ticked, the role is saved with no number whatever the number box holds, unticked it needs a whole number from 1 to 1000 — and neither a number nor the tick is refused at the number's box with every typed box kept and the tick brought back; turning a role from numbered to none and back is audited by the field `needed`, and a save that changes nothing writes nothing (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a role without a number, then the card's role header reads «3 · fără număr» where a numbered role reads «3 din 10» and the assignment button «Ajutor · 3 · fără număr», the card's closed line counts only the roles with a number and adds «+ roluri fără număr» when there is one (with none numbered, «3 în roluri fără număr»), the role is never full whatever the number of people given it, and «Câte ecusoane» starts it at the people given the role — never the cancelled — where a numbered role starts at its number, the box staying the club's to change (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Migration `0163_volunteer_role_no_number` is expand-only: it drops the NOT NULL of `event_volunteer_roles.needed` and replaces its CHECK by `needed IS NULL OR needed >= 1` under the same name, so every role from before keeps its number and its people, NULL is accepted, and zero or a negative number is still refused by the table; and an event's JSON file carries `needed: null` for such a role and reads it back, a file from before reading as it always did (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 36, 40 and 43 (§761, §773, §780). Given an event with a role without a number, then the volunteers' page offers that role however many people it was given, the form is never closed for lack of a role that needs people while it exists, the event page's «Căutăm voluntari: …» lists it, and its tile says «mai sunt locuri» and never a number — with «Arată public câți voluntari mai sunt necesari» on as well — while a numbered role beside it still says how many people it needs (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
